Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, portables, classrooms, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; integrates condition data with student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Ch. 3, Appendices 1-3).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections through 2029 with methodology from SchoolWorks; site-level capacity utilization data including classrooms and square footage; explicit connection of enrollment trends to rightsizing strategies, closures, consolidations, and adaptive space uses (Ch. 2, Demographics and Enrollment Analysis).

Educational Alignment.justification: Facilities Master Plan explicitly integrates district mission and educational goals; detailed educational specifications addressing TK, CTE, special education, wellness centers, and collaborative learning spaces; facility projects directly respond to educational program needs and instructional priorities (Executive Summary, Guiding Principles, and site-specific plans).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data on outdoor spaces including playgrounds, turf fields, shade structures, and stormwater management; detailed strategies for campus greening such as artificial turf fields, permeable surfaces, rain gardens, and outdoor learning environments; greening framed as climate resilience and wellness strategy (Site plans and Executive Summary).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Climate readiness and resilience are central themes throughout the plan; comprehensive climate risk assessment addressing snow loads, wildfire, and weather disruptions; detailed mitigation strategies including structural roof upgrades, backup power, stormwater management, and sustainable design integrated district-wide and site-specific (Executive Summary, Guiding Principles, Structural Narrative).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Significant detail on energy use baselines, targets, and strategies; references to Title 24, Zero Net Energy goals, and DSA Sustainability Review; plans for electrification, solar PV, battery storage, microgrids, HVAC upgrades, and decarbonization; energy resilience linked to climate disruptions and cost savings (Sustainability section, Executive Summary).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, escalation, contingencies, and soft costs; clear prioritization framework aligned with safety, equity, program alignment, lifecycle cost, and climate resilience; multiple funding sources identified including bonds, state programs, developer fees; long-term financial sustainability and project phasing addressed (Appendix 2, Budget Model).
